title: CMDAR: A Chinese Multi-scene Dynamic Audio Reasoning Benchmark with Diverse Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the impact of different instruction phrasings on model selection behavior by testing four distinct instruction prompts for multiple-choice questions and comparing the resulting accuracy variations.

Analyzing the tendency of models to select high-frequency options by ensuring balanced option distribution, mutually exclusive option content, and randomizing the order of options in multiple-choice tasks.
